data.body: **[P2] Keep a healthy peer active across the fault deadline.** The healthy invocation is released and completed before the driver waits for the fault's deadline. This establishes ordinary overlap but cannot detect deadline cleanup that interrupts unrelated active work. Recovery probes need not start before that boundary either. Start the healthy peer sufficiently late to retain its own timeout budget, hold it across the fault deadline, and require continued progress from the same request/process before releasing it. Include a negative control where deadline handling interrupts the peer.
